title: backlog.py runs names the process record of a running land or stage-back as the item's worker pid
goal: runs names a land or stage-back that holds the item's key by what it is, not as the worker pid of the item

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
sys.path.insert(0, R + '/_tools')
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '-b', 'main', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
    if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = 'doing'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted doing')
for s in ('claimed', 'working', 'returned', 'landing'): c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s)  # a land is running on the item
holder = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time; time.sleep(60)'])  # the land's process, with its own/ record
os.environ['KB_COORD_STORE'] = S
import bl_clean
code = bl_clean.record_owner('process', holder.pid, item=iid)
r = bl('runs', iid)
holder.kill()
print('runs line of an item with a land running:', r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[:1])
sys.exit(0 if 'worker pid' not in r.stdout else 1)
